english-grammar 10 grouped questions with delayed grading

questions.question: Everyone has climbed up to the top of the mountain, ______?
questions.explanation: 主句为现在完成时的肯定句，反意疑问用 haven't；everyone 可由 they 承接。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is CORRECT?
questions.explanation: all the apples 的限定词次序正确；all of 后接带限定词的名词短语，whole 不能这样修饰复数 apples。

options.text: Henry is so hungry that he eats all of apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats the all apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats whole the apples that you give him.
Henry is so hungry that he eats all the apples that you give him.

questions.question: All of the plants now farmed on a large scale were developed from plants ______ wild.
questions.explanation: that 引导修饰 plants 的定语从句并作主语；其余选项缺少正确的连接结构。

questions.question: How can I ever complete it if you ______ continually ______ me so many silly questions?
questions.explanation: are continually asking 表示当下不断提问，进行时与 continually 连用可表达不满。

questions.question: He ______ have been nervous because he didn't go straight in.
questions.explanation: because 后给出判断依据；must have been 表示推断他当时一定紧张。

questions.question: What should I have done in Tom’s place? The italicized part of the sentence expresses ______.
questions.explanation: in Tom’s place = 假如我是 Tom、处在他的境地，语义上提供隐含条件，因此是 hypothesis。不是具体坐在 Tom 的位置上。

questions.question: ______, he should be punished if he goes against the law.
questions.explanation: Be he A or B = Whether he be A or B，意为“不论他是 A 还是 B”。这是保留动词原形 be 的正式旧式句型；不要靠日常语感改成 was。

options.text: Whether the president or the citizen
Was he the president or the citizen
Be he the president or the citizen
Were he the president or the citizen

questions.question: Which of the following sentences expresses SURPRISE?
questions.explanation: B：“你怎么竟会觉得是我做的？”A 为 should 条件倒装；C 为委婉提出看法；D 为建议或义务。要从语境识别 should，不要只背一个中文义。

options.text: Should it rain tomorrow, I wouldn’t go.
I don’t know why you should think that I did it.
I should say that it would be better to try it again.
You should inform the receptionist of your arrival.

questions.question: The rhetorical question "Is that a reason for despair?" implies ______.
questions.explanation: 反问意在否定：这不是绝望的理由，而非真正询问信息。

questions.question: "Is that true? Aren't you stretching it a bit?" These two questions are used to ______.
questions.explanation: 询问是否属实并质疑是否夸大，是表达怀疑，尚未直接否定事实。

checks.name: english-vocabulary 20 grouped questions with delayed grading

questions.question: In order to ______ the identity of a candidate, we may ask you to show your ID.
questions.explanation: verify 核实是否属实；examine 检查研究；ensure 确保某结果；testify 提供证言、作证，常用 testify to/that。凭证件核实身份，用 verify。

questions.question: The mayor ______ his political view on the radio.
questions.explanation: set forth 表示阐述、陈述观点；set up 建立，set about 着手，set in 开始并持续。

questions.question: The deal ______ before it was signed and sealed, even after the Letter of Intent was drawn up.
questions.explanation: fall through 计划、交易落空；fall for 上当或迷恋；fall in with 偶遇、同意；fall out 争吵失和或掉落。交易未签成，选 fell through。

questions.question: I am terribly ______ after a whole day’s working.
questions.explanation: worn out 筋疲力尽；worn down 被长期消磨、拖垮；worn away 磨蚀；worn off 效果消退。干了一整天后累坏了，优先 worn out。

questions.question: If you are like most people, then chances are you often ______ others while they are still talking.
questions.explanation: interrupt others 指打断别人说话；interfere、intervene 通常还需介词，disturb 指打扰。

questions.question: Mary was <u>in a lather</u> when she heard that she would be transferred to another department. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: in a lather 焦躁不安、激动，选 agitated；scared 害怕；hesitant 犹豫；shocked 震惊。字面是“泡沫”，此处是习语。

questions.question: A teacher who is skillful in delivering his lecture can undoubtedly ______ the mind of students.
questions.explanation: inspire 启发思想、激起灵感；encourage 鼓励、给予信心；motivate 提供行动动力；promote 促进或晋升。这里 the mind 与启发思维相连，选 inspire。

questions.question: We finished all of the food <u>at a sitting</u>. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: at a sitting 表示一口气、一次坐下来期间，最接近 at one time；in time 及时，on time 准时。

questions.question: Never believe Tom, who was such a ______ character.
questions.explanation: suspicious 可表示令人怀疑、不可信的，与 Never believe 相呼应；gracious 亲切，conspicuous 显眼。

questions.question: The French, long proud of their reputation for high-class cuisine, strongly ______ on the saying: they are the least attracted to quick meals.
questions.explanation: frown on 表示不赞同、反对；reckon on 与 figure on 表指望，speculate on 表推测或投机。此处表达对该说法的不赞同。

questions.question: His car was ______ to avoid bumping against the roadblock.
questions.explanation: swerve 指使车辆突然改变方向、急转弯，吻合避开路障。

questions.question: The place did not appear to be popular, for it was completely deserted, and in any case ______ to traffic.
questions.explanation: inaccessible to traffic 表示交通无法到达；incompatible with 才表示不相容。

questions.question: Being ______ about food can not only make children suffer from malnutrition but also influence their growth of intelligence.
questions.explanation: be particular about food 表示挑食；partial 常与 to 搭配，peculiar 奇特，pathetic 可怜。

questions.question: Scientists first ______ the idea of atomic bomb in the 1930’s.
questions.explanation: conceive an idea 构想、提出想法；perceive 感知、察觉；deceive 欺骗；relieve 缓解。先在头脑中构思，用 conceive。

questions.question: The official ______ the interview on the sensitive issue.
questions.explanation: turn down an interview 表示拒绝采访；turn back 返回，turn around 转向，turn out 结果是。

questions.question: We ______ to refund your money if you are not satisfied with your purchase.
questions.explanation: guarantee to do 承诺做；assure sb of/that 使人放心；ensure that 确保结果；insure 给……保险。能直接接 to refund 表承诺的是 guarantee。

questions.question: I hope to ______ my umbrella which I left in the taxi.
questions.explanation: retrieve 找回、取回遗失物；restore 恢复原状态、修复；retain 保留；repel 排斥、击退。伞留在出租车上，希望“找回”，选 retrieve。

questions.question: If you are not sure of the address, call and ask ______ to the interview.
questions.explanation: prior to = before，作为介词短语表示“在面试之前”。former 前任、前者；preceding 紧前的；previous 先前的，都不直接构成这里的 ______ to。

questions.question: Topics for composition should be ______ to the experiences and interests of students.
questions.explanation: be relevant to 表示与……相关；写作主题应与学生的经历、兴趣相关。

questions.question: He planned to steal the money, but his ______ were discovered.
questions.explanation: schemes 可指秘密策划的阴谋、诡计，吻合偷钱计划被发现。

english-grammar 20 alternate size works

questions.question: "Is that true? Aren't you stretching it a bit?" These two questions are used to ______.
questions.explanation: 询问是否属实并质疑是否夸大，是表达怀疑，尚未直接否定事实。

questions.question: Among the four sentences below, Sentence ______ expresses the highest degree of possibility.
questions.explanation: will 在此作肯定的将来预测，确定程度高于 could、may 的可能性及 should 的预期。

questions.question: An actor cannot well play the role without life experience ______ a dancer can make a difference without much practice.
questions.explanation: not/cannot A any more than B = 正如 B 不能一样，A 也不能。前面已经有 cannot，后面用 any more than；不是再添一个 no more than。两项都是说缺少积累就无法成功。

questions.question: Michelle is said ______ some progress in her scientific research in the past year.
questions.explanation: is said 后接不定式；进步发生在此前一年，用完成式 to have made。

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is a COMMAND?
questions.explanation: Try that again. 要求再次尝试，是祈使命令；其余分别表达称赞、祝愿或请求原谅。

questions.question: In "He will come to learn driving from you", the infinitive indicates ______.
questions.explanation: to learn… 说明来这里的目的，作目的状语。

questions.question: Many reporters hurried to the airport, only to be told that the superstar had already left. The infinitive verb phrase only to be told is used ______.
questions.explanation: only to do 在此引出出乎意料且令人失望的结果：赶到机场却被告知明星已经离开。

options.text: to indicate a high degree of possibility

questions.question: There ______ be any difficulty in passing the road test since you have practiced a lot in the driving school.
questions.explanation: shouldn't 在此表示按已有练习情况预计不会有困难；mustn't 表禁止，needn't 表不必。

questions.question: In phrases like steaming hot, shining bright, biting cold, the -ING participle is used ______.
questions.explanation: 这些 -ing 形式强化后面形容词的程度，如热气腾腾、刺骨寒冷，起强调作用。

questions.question: Please contact us at 4777 8886 whenever ______.
questions.explanation: convenient 通常以 it 作主语表示事情方便；时间从句表达将来时用一般现在时。

options.text: it will be convenient to you

questions.question: "—Must I come at four o'clock?" "—No, you needn't come at four o'clock." The modal auxiliary verbs in the conversation imply ______.
questions.explanation: must 询问是否必要，needn't 否定必要性，表示不必四点来。

questions.question: ______ you ______ any doubt on the delivery receipt, contact us at 4008 9666.
questions.explanation: Should you have… = If you should have…，“万一有疑问，请联系”。这是将来可能条件，可直接接祈使主句，不要求主句也用 would。

questions.question: Which of the following italicized phrases indicates CAUSE?
questions.explanation: D 表示因看到可怕景象而害怕，说明原因；A 表范围，B 表目的，C 表让步。

options.text: The temperature varies from 30 degrees to minus 20.
I work hard so as to get promoted.
For all his efforts, he didn't pass the exam.
I was frightened at the terrible sight.

questions.question: Tom told his father ______ had happened.
questions.explanation: all 是 told 的宾语，that 引导定语从句并在从句中作主语；整体相当于 what had happened。

questions.question: It's no good ______ her. She is such a miser that she won't spare a penny out.
questions.explanation: It's no good doing… 表示做某事无益；turn to sb 表示向某人求助。

questions.question: It is a fine day today. Let's go to the park for boating, ______?
questions.explanation: Let's… 提出共同活动的建议，反意疑问通常用 shall we?。

questions.question: Susan is ______ as an “addlehead”—she always leaves her keys on the door.
questions.explanation: what is known as… = 所谓的、被称作……的那种人或事物。what 引导名词性表语从句；这里重在称呼或类别，不是普通的 who 定语从句。

questions.question: It is generally believed that teaching is ______ it is a science.
questions.explanation: as much an art as a science = 既是一门科学，也同样是一门艺术。顺序是 as much + a/an + 单数名词 + as，不是 as an art much。

questions.question: —Have you returned from Japan yet? —Yes, but I ______ at home for only four days before my company sent me to Australia.
questions.explanation: sent 把“在家待四天”限定为过去结束的时段，用 was。for + 时间长度也能搭配一般过去时，不能看到 for 就自动选现在完成时。

questions.question: It is said that more than one organization ______ in this well-known criminal case.
questions.explanation: more than one + 单数名词，意义不止一个，语法上通常仍接单数谓语；be involved in 涉及、卷入。不是按中文“不止一个组织”就选 were。

checks.name: english-vocabulary 10 alternate size works

questions.question: It's hard to change many Americans' ______ view that Germans lack a sense of humor and are always buried in work.
questions.explanation: stereotypical 指以固定模式概括群体的刻板看法，吻合对德国人的概括。

questions.question: I was feeling <u>dragged out</u> so I went home. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: dragged out 在此指筋疲力尽，对应 exhausted；不是“被拖出去”。tedious 令人厌烦；cold 寒冷；sick 生病。

questions.question: Benjamin was <u>sweating bullets</u> by the time the police had finished questioning him. The underlined part means ______.
questions.explanation: sweat bullets 是极度紧张、害怕得冒汗的习语，对应 very frightened。

questions.question: I’m supposed to go to the meeting, but I have an <u>out</u>—Sam invited me first to come to his wedding. The underlined word means ______.
questions.explanation: an out = 脱身的办法、退出的借口；这里有婚礼邀请可作为不参加会议的理由。out 不只是副词“出去”。

questions.question: Our journey was slow because the train stopped ______ at different villages.
questions.explanation: continually 一次又一次，允许间断；continuously 连续不断；unceasingly 不停歇；gradually 逐渐。火车是走一段停一次，属于反复而非始终停止。

questions.question: Time is a ______ performer. It flies, marches on, heals all wounds, runs out and will tell.
questions.explanation: versatile 多才多艺、用途多样，吻合时间会“飞、前进、疗伤、耗尽、揭示”；fertile 富有创造力或肥沃；fruitful 有成果；productive 多产。

questions.question: This sweater is made of ______ wool and is much warmer than other kinds of sweater.
questions.explanation: pure wool 指纯羊毛材料；utter、thorough 不用于这里的材料纯度。

questions.question: The police have received ______ information that the wanted murderer is still on the run.
questions.explanation: credible information 指可信的信息；chaotic 混乱，chronic 长期的，cautious 谨慎的。

questions.question: In the present economic ______ we cannot make even greater progress than previously.
questions.explanation: economic climate 指经济环境、经济形势；其余选项不构成这里的惯用表达。

questions.question: These low-budget animated films are the main source of ______ of this independent studio.
questions.explanation: income 指工作室的收入来源；pay、salary、wage 通常指个人工作报酬。
